Messages.Author: Tammy, Chris, and Alex Shorb
Messages.Body:
Hi LSJ -

Subject says it all, but I am assuming that since they are considered
out of the game, they stay where they are until only one uncontested
copy is left.

I also assume that whoever it is on must pay the contestion - i.e. I
end my turn w/Millicent, then she moves to my predator. Then after my
predator's turn, she moves again. Then at my master I bring out
another Millicent. Then at my grand-predator's turn, they get to
choose whether to pay to contest Millicent, or yeild.

Chris
